purpose: Obtain actual CUDA kernel costs before selecting more engine changes

tool.installation: Portable package; no CUDA, PATH, driver, power-policy or operating-system changes

preflight: Native Nsight CLI runs and a bounded backend test produced 195 real CUDA kernel records, including the candidate's GDN alpha/beta fusion kernel

capture.recipe: MTP3, ub512, dynamic vocabulary 16384, lazy PLE, context 262144 and automatic threads
capture.request: Existing Rust case; 128-token warmup, then a 128-token cached-prompt request
capture.collection: Start only after readiness and warmup, then stop and finalize the trace after the single measured request. Explicitly stop only the uniquely marked profiling server PID afterward; do not rely on Ctrl+C under the profiler.
capture.scope: Kernel-duration diagnostic, not a speed comparison. Graph-node tracing can perturb execution; summed kernel durations need not equal wall time or isolated operator latency.
capture.routed_expert_ids: Not captured by this trace; routed-ID overlap remains unmeasured

publication: Only sanitized provenance, capture metadata and aggregate kernel statistics; raw responses, traces and SQLite exports stay private
recovery: The hardware-trace pilot's incomplete-event warning and failed native-console cleanup attempt are retained separately. Software tracing with explicit owned-PID cleanup also reported incomplete events. Do not accept these captures for kernel ranking.

natural_exit_followup.reason: Test normal application exit rather than another console-control or interactive-stop workaround
natural_exit_followup.application: Installed llama-cli with the same runtime DLLs and MTP3/Q4_K/ub512/dynamic-vocabulary-16384 model recipe
natural_exit_followup.workload: Single-turn, 128-token Rust chat request, greedy sampling, ignore EOS, reasoning off
natural_exit_followup.capture: Full application lifetime, software CUDA tracing, host-only graph nodes, stop-on-exit
natural_exit_followup.scope: Includes initialization, default model warmup, chat prompt, generation and teardown. Not the cached raw-completion server workload, not pure decode and not a speed comparison.
natural_exit_followup.acceptance: Normal zero exit, positive MTP activity, requested output length, nonzero CUDA kernel records, no diagnostic warning/error about incomplete or dropped events, unchanged runtime hashes and complete process/GPU cleanup

deployment: No installed binary, model or deployment launcher changes
